shared_elements: animal or creature figures rendered in low relief/incision
quadruped-like forms with limbs splayed from a body
justification: Both surfaces carry incised/relief creature imagery with limbed bodies, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes: A shows a dense, tiered composition of multiple distinct animals (birds/quadrupeds/serpentine forms) organised into horizontal registers along the top and face of a pillar, while B shows a single isolated radiating, many-limbed figure (spider- or star-like) floating alone on a flat rock face. The register-based multi-animal programme of A has no counterpart in the solitary, centred, symmetrical motif of B, and the rendering conventions (carefully modelled profile animals vs a schematic linear radial form) differ markedly.
